title: Trevor Philips' last chase in GTA 5's Ending A
subject: trevor
description:
Would you have pulled the trigger on Trevor? 👇

The grave in Ludendorff, the order from the FIB and the ending where Franklin ends Trevor's story. Spoilers for the ending of Grand Theft Auto V.

scenes.text: Trevor Philips dug up his best friend's grave.
Back in Ludendorff, in Bury the Hatchet, he found Brad's body inside Michael's coffin.
Brad had died in 2004. Trevor had spent nine years thinking he was in prison.
To the FIB, Trevor was a loose end. Agent Steve Haines told Franklin to kill him.
In Ending A, Something Sensible, Franklin chases him to the oil fields, where his truck hits a leaking fuel tank and burns.
In the Deathwish ending, Trevor fights beside Michael and Franklin.
Most fans see Deathwish as canon, so the grave in Ludendorff holds only Brad.
